evidencePolicy: Evidence observations, not product mappings. `recorded-counterpart` means the controlled Grok corpus recorded a native signal serving a comparable rendering purpose, cited by corpus scenario and event sequence; semantics may still differ (see note) and Stage 2 decides the actual mapping and ownership. `not-recorded` means no controlled scenario recorded a counterpart; it does not claim Grok lacks one. Evidence cited under `not-recorded` shows the nearest recorded mechanism only.
